content.title: Sixers Streaming
content.text: Here’s everything you need to know to watch and stream the Sixers: How do I stream the 76ers online? If you live in the Philadelphia 76ers team territory and have a provider that includes NBC Sports Philadelphia, you can stream the 76ers on the NBC Sports app or right here. Can I stream the 76ers if I do not have cable? If you do not have cable, NBC Sports Philadelphia is included on Hulu, Peacock and YouTube TV. What if the stream is not working? If you are experiencing technical issues with the stream, please visit help.nbc.com, where you can submit a question, find additional tutorials and FAQs, and learn more about streaming all of the content from NBC’s family of networks. Can I stream the 76ers in the NBC Sports Philadelphia app? Authenticated live streaming for 76ers’ games on NBC Sports Philadelphia is exclusively on the NBC Sports app. The NBC Sports Philadelphia app will link to the NBC Sports app to make it easy to find. Keep checking the NBC Sports Philadelphia app for all the latest news, highlights, and analysis. When do the 76ers play? You can find the Philadelphia 76ers’ full schedule here. Stay with NBC Philadelphia and follow us on Twitter and Instagram for all of your Sixers coverage throughout the season.
